_comment_purpose:
此文件是 CN app 所有运行时配置的真实信息单一真相源。
构建流程（ota_config.yaml）独立配置，不引用此文件。
前端需要 VITE_API_BASE、VITE_WS_URL、VITE_CLOUDBASE_ENV_ID，通过 CI/CD 注入到 .env.cn 构建文件。
_comment_bucket_roles: Two separate buckets exist for this app: (1) the OTA bucket used by CI/CD and read by clients checking for updates — name lives in ota/config/ota_config.yaml (currently 'ecan-releases-1251680599'). (2) the runtime app-storage bucket used by utils/storage/get_storage_provider() for user uploads / avatars / exports — the storage_bucket/cdn/region fields below (currently 'ecan-skills-1251680599'). They MUST stay separate; never point an OTA artifact upload at the runtime bucket.
_comment_field_naming: 字段命名与 apps/intl/config/cloud_endpoints.json 完全一致，方便代码统一读取（utils/app_config_loader.py 通过 _endpoints.get(name) 取值，utils/storage/*.py 通过 storage_region / storage_bucket / cdn 读取）。CN 端独有的扩展字段放在最后，以 _ 开头或 backend_ 前缀以便区分。
